summary: EMLex is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in lexicography, the making of dictionaries. You study at a home university, such as Santiago de Compostela, Braga, Budapest, Hildesheim, Tbilisi, Nancy or Rome, and spend the summer semester of 2028 with the whole class in Erlangen. About 20 scholarships pay participation costs and €1,400 a month. Apply by 1 February 2027.
meta_title: EMLex 2027: Erasmus Mundus lexicography master's scholarship
meta_description: EMLex pays participation costs and €1,400 a month for a two-year lexicography master's taught in English and German. Apply by 1 February 2027.
covers: Participation costs: tuition, health insurance, library, administration and cultural events.
€1,400 a month for up to 24 months, for travel, visas, residence permits, settling in and living costs.
Students without a scholarship may be offered reduced fees of €2,000 instead of €4,000.
eligibility: Applicants who have not held an Erasmus Mundus scholarship before. At most 30 places a year.

A degree in linguistics (including computational or applied), languages, translation, communication or media, book studies, library and information science, or a related field. Final-year students can apply.

Teaching is in English and German. You need certificates in both: at least B1 reception in each and B2 production in one, no more than two years old (for English, for example, IELTS 5.5 to 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 72 for B2).
how_to_apply: Fill in the application form digitally and upload it on the University of Santiago de Compostela's EMLex portal by 1 February 2027.
Include a motivation letter of up to two pages in English or German, your degree certificates, transcripts, language certificates and ID, all as PDFs of no more than 10 MB in total.
If you are offered a scholarship you have ten days to accept it.
watch_out: German is required: without a B1 German certificate (such as onSET-Deutsch or Goethe-Zertifikat) you cannot be admitted.
The 2027 intake cannot start at Erlangen, because the joint summer semester 2028 is held there.
The programme asks applicants to write their motivation letter themselves, without AI-generated text.
documents: Motivation letter, two pages, in English or German

faq.a: 1 February 2027, inclusive, for Erasmus Mundus scholarships for the 2027 intake.

faq.q: Do I need German for EMLex?
faq.a: Yes. Lectures are in English and German, so you need certificates in both, at least B1 in each and B2 in one.

faq.q: How many EMLex scholarships are there?
faq.a: About 20 for the 2027 intake, out of up to 30 places.
